books.title: Vampire: The Masquerade 20th Anniversary Edition
notes: 233 checked named entries; contents/index audit identifies further sections still to source.
Published dot levels are preserved separately from MET tiers and costs.
Celerity, Fortitude and Potence ranks1-5 have no individually named V20 powers; no names are fabricated.
Missing sections include some Thaumaturgy paths, rituals, combinations and Chapter Ten Disciplines (15 families).

books.title: Vampire 20th Anniversary Dark Ages (Final Download)
notes: 55 individually verified named powers across 7 Disciplines; ToC/index review identifies further sections to source.
Currently represented DA20 Disciplines: Abombwe, Animalism, Auspex, Dominate, Obfuscate, Presence, Protean.
Remaining DA20 bloodlines, appendices, paths, rituals, combinations and other Disciplines are not yet covered.
